description: GuiaFlow turns product screenshots into interactive guided tours with highlights, clicks, text, and optional narrated audio. Tours can be published as permanent links or embedded on a site, with hosted analytics and AI features on the Pro plan.
summary: GuiaFlow exposes two developer integration surfaces on app.guiaflow.pro: a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `/mcp` and a REST API at `/v1` with an OpenAPI spec, both authenticated by either GuiaFlow OAuth or a `gf_live_` API key.
